artifacts.summary: Keep-plus-add outcome: playwright-verify.mjs kept as required batch gate, Playwright MCP added as optional ad hoc single-slide debugging capability for present/slidev-assembly-agent, with written justification and consistency sweep.

completion_data.completion_summary: Gave the present extension its own scoped Playwright MCP permission grant (9-tool enumeration mirroring web's), authorized slidev-assembly-agent to call 4 of those tools for ad hoc single-slide inspection, and added a written justification in slidev-pitfalls.md for keeping playwright-verify.mjs as the required batch verification gate alongside the new ad hoc MCP workflow. Swept 4 downstream doc/index references for wording consistency and confirmed founder needs no functional edit.

memory_candidates.content: When an extension needs its own scoped MCP permission grant mirroring an existing extension's (e.g. present needing web's Playwright grant), create a new settings-fragment.json in the consuming extension with the exact enumerated tool list copied verbatim, plus a manifest.json merge_targets.settings entry ({"source": "settings-fragment.json", "target": ".claude/settings.local.json"}), rather than adding the source extension as a dependency. Adding as a dependency pulls in unrelated agents/skills/rules; a wildcard grant (mcp__server__*) is never acceptable when the server has a documented safe/unsafe tool split, per mcp-server-ownership.md's carve-out.

check-extension-docs.sh enforces that every index-entries.json entry's declared line_count matches the actual file's line count. Editing a prose file that is also indexed (e.g. a *.md file listed in an extension's index-entries.json) requires updating its line_count field in the same change, or the doc-lint gate regresses. The repo provides generate-context-line-counts.sh --write to auto-fix these, but running it unscoped touches every extension's index -- always diff the result and revert any out-of-scope file it touched before committing.
